name: shader-dot-orbit
title: Shader Dot Orbit
description: A loose grid of colored dots, each orbiting inside its own cell: a structured, network-like WebGL backdrop.
useWhen: You want a structured dot-grid backdrop with gentle orbital motion.
A tech scene benefits from a regular pattern that reads as a network or a system.
avoidWhen: You want a static dot grid: use a CSS grid instead.
You want organic, flowing motion: use shader-warp or shader-metaballs.
The regular pattern would clash with dense foreground content.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 10 colors, comma separated, spread over the dots.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the dots orbit. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Dot size relative to its cell.

variables.label: Size range
variables.description: How much the dot sizes vary.

variables.label: Spreading
variables.description: How far each dot wanders from its cell center.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the grid in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster but softens the fine detail.
